teks_soal: The Honest Woodcutter Once, a poor woodcutter lived near a river. Every day, he collected wood from the forest and sold it in the village. The mysterious man wants to take the woodcutter's axe.
The woodcutter wants to sell a golden axe.
The villagers refuse to buy his wood.
